description: This file defines the CacheInterface in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for getting, setting, and removing cache items.

classes.name: CacheInterface
classes.description: Interface for cache operations in AWS SDK, including get, set, and remove methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key, returning the value or null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cache item with a specified key, value, and optional TTL (time-to-live).
